Question: Which of the candidate cows (Cow10, Cow01, Cow07) is the boxed cow? Compare tag colour and which ear, white markings, body size/shape. Also label her behaviour.

input.evidence: Zoom at the case time and at +20 s: the cow is standing by the east fence with her head lowered and her muzzle against the cow lying beside her, so she is nosing or licking her. She has a green tag in the ear nearest the camera and a pale blue/teal tag in the other ear. No white markings show. She is a smaller, younger-looking build. The sequence shows she walked down along the fence between -20 s and -5 s, then stayed at the lying cow from 0 to +20 s. None of the three reference images were available, so I could not compare her with Cow10, Cow01 or Cow07. With the tracker margin at only 0.04, I'm not confirming any candidate.
input.self_check: Behaviour: confirmed by two zooms 20 s apart and a 4-frame sequence. She stays in muzzle contact for at least 20 s. If she was only sniffing the ground next to the lying cow, the label would be standing. She also walked for part of the minute, so walking is possible. Ears look upright, flank looks normal and no discharge is visible at this resolution. Identity: left unresolved because there were no reference crops. Her tag colours (green in one ear, blue in the other) should be checked against the herd tag records.
